jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw ORIGINAL cargo sprites for a Chinese 2D transport management game.
The attached railway game atlases are reference ONLY for cargo CATEGORIES and their small-icon readability. Invent original shapes and details; do not copy exact sprites, branding, writing, or licensed characters. Ignore all people, trains and UI. Use cheerful 2D cartoon game art with clean dark brown/navy outlines, simple bright cel-shaded colors, compact recognizable shapes, restrained shallow top/side perspective, and only 2 or 3 shading tones per material. Coordinate with big-headed cartoon passenger art. No photorealism, heavy texture or glossy 3D. Each item must remain recognizable at 60-90 pixels tall.
ONE landscape sprite atlas, exactly FOUR COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, eight well-separated complete sprites, one specified cargo type per equal cell. Read the row-major order carefully. Equal visual scale and weights, generous transparent gutters and 12% padding around every object. Never draw the cell frames. All items slightly face LEFT, broad main front and narrow right side, shallow top face, consistent light from upper left. No floor, ground shadows, platform, motion effects, labels, text, numbers, brands or watermark.
CRITICAL: return an actual transparent RGBA PNG with alpha=0 in all empty background areas. Do NOT paint a checkerboard pattern. No black, white or colored background. Full object silhouettes, no overlap, no cropping. A cargo item may be a compact cluster of its specified contents, but each cell must have only one distinct kind of cargo.
Requested output 2048x1024, 4 by 2 layout.

Use case: background-extraction. The attached image is the EDIT TARGET, an original 4-column by 2-row cargo sprite atlas.
Keep all EIGHT cargo items EXACTLY as shown, in the same order, scale and positions: suitcase, folded sweater, noodle cup, teddy bear; computer set, wooden crate, postal parcel, duffel bag. Do not redraw the items or change colors or perspective.
Remove ONLY the grey checkerboard which is erroneously baked into the background, including all empty gaps within the handles, between computer parts and around each object's outline. Return a PNG encoded with a GENUINE RGBA alpha channel. Every empty background pixel must have alpha ZERO. A checkerboard is not transparency. Do not replace it with black or white. Preserve opaque objects, crisp clean edges and all eight separate silhouettes. No background pattern, no floor, no shadow, no text or labels. Production transparent game sprite atlas, not a preview of transparency.
